name: manual_3abcef
claim: Working rules the operator set on 2026-11-25 for this kind of multi-repo night: commit only in durable canonical folders (the repo checkouts and worktrees under the code directories), never in <local-tmp-dir> or a TMPDIR, because those are cleared on reboot; base new work on the latest open PR tip after fetching; and do not push until told, so commits stay local and the one push per repo comes last. Codex helper worktrees under <local-tmp-dir> are theirs; take their commits by fast-forwarding a durable branch to the ref, never by working in the temporary folder.

decisions.notes: Operator instruction during the AlphaClaw/OpenClaw update; the reboot that night cleared scratch folders.

rationale: Operator instruction during the AlphaClaw/OpenClaw update; the reboot that night cleared scratch folders.
